name: Operating System Engineering & Advanced OS
summary: Building and extending real kernels: booting, kernel memory and scheduling, drivers, advanced and distributed file systems, high-performance I/O and OS research.

topics.name: Building a teaching kernel (xv6 or similar)
Kernel memory allocation and page-table management
Interrupts, exceptions and context switching in depth
Advanced file systems: log-structured and copy-on-write (ZFS, Btrfs)
Storage stacks: RAID, SSD internals and NVMe
Kernel bypass and high-performance I/O (io_uring, DPDK)
OS research designs: exokernels, microkernels and seL4
